head.description: This gem of a pheno was hunted and preserved by a well known trap grower on LAs Skid Row. After 2 years in tissue culture it came back to bless those that smoke it. Originally bred by Seed Junkie.Lineage: Orange Cookies x Triangle KushTerpene Profile: Linalool, Limonene, Caryophyllene, MyrceneOrange Push Pop Disposable Vape by Clade9 is available now at Highway 90 Dispensary in Marlton, NJ. Clade 9, the premium cannabis cultivation brand behind this exquisite cartridge, is celebrated for its commitment to genetic diversity and unique terpene profiles. Their dedication to producing high-quality flower strains ensures that every puff delivers the exceptional quality and consistency that discerning cannabis users expect.Purchasing your Orange Push Pop 1g Disposable Vape at Highway 90 isn’t just a transaction—it’s an experience. Conveniently located at 90 Old Marlton Pike W in Marlton, NJ, our shop is at the crossroads of Route 70 and Route 73, directly across from Marlton Crossing. Serving the communities of Evesham, Cherry Hill, Voorhees Township, Medford, and Mt. Laurel, we offer a welcoming environment where cannabis enthusiasts can find high-quality products with ease.At Highway 90, we understand that cannabis is personal. Our knowledgeable team is here to ensure you find exactly what you need, whether it’s top-shelf flower, potent concentrates, delicious edibles, or soothing topicals. Our commitment to quality, education, and exceptional service makes us Marlton’s go-to recreational dispensary. Conveniently accessible from Cherry Hill and Philadelphia, Highway 90 offers a seamless shopping experience, competitive pricing, and a selection curated with care.Stop by today and experience the Highway 90 difference—where quality meets community, and every visit is unforgettable. Located near the AMC 8, Chickie's & Pete's, and The Promenade, Highway 90 is your closest destination for premium cannabis products.Disposable vaporizers contain concentrated cannabis oil that is heated by an attached battery and inhaled. These products come charged and ready to go, and are not designed to be reused, refilled, or recharged. These products are often very potent and are designed to be consumed in 2-3 second puffs.
